---
name: Bug report
about: A reproducible problem with this self-hosting kit
---

Describe expected and actual behavior, kit commit/release, host OS/architecture, Docker/Compose versions, affected tool and sanitized reproduction steps. State whether this is a source-test failure, a container-start failure or incorrect live page content.

Do not include `.env.local`, OAuth data, private URLs, scraped personal data or unredacted logs. Report vulnerabilities privately using the Security tab.
